summary: Add 'reader subscriptions' as a list command whose local cache is the syncable 'reader' resource (GET /reader/subscriptions), with integer --limit validation matching sibling list commands.
reason: The spec and generated CLI cover only the writer-side subscriber surface. GET /reader/subscriptions is the global API endpoint for the signed-in user's followed publications. Offline/local reads must use a resource that sync (and auto-refresh) populate; an unsyncable cache name leaves --data-source local and network fallback empty after sync.
